```yaml
name: TS Audit
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "packages/typescript/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ts.audit.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "packages/typescript/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ts.audit.yml"

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm install -g pnpm
          pnpm install

      - name: Run audit
        run: |
          cd packages/typescript
          pnpm run audit
```
